doc.name: agent-bev
doc.description: The world's largest agentic B2B hub for beer, wine and spirits. Powered by CUVEE. Trade only.

none.description: no account; every call answers without authentication

supportedInterfaces.description: the buyers' door, one door across every open node

skills.name: search_drinks
skills.description: Find beers, wines, spirits, ciders and ready-to-drink drinks by name, style, origin or category across every open country node. Returns record ids with each record's CUVEE.

skills.name: get_record
skills.description: Read one product in full by record_id: every field with its source page, reader and state; its CUVEE; its claim status; the signed record (JWS).

skills.name: find_producer
skills.description: Find a maker and its products across every open node, with the maker's name as each source wrote it.

skills.name: list_nodes
skills.description: List the countries on the record: each node's door, languages, state and, for an open node, its counts.

skills.name: compare_drinks
skills.description: Compare two to ten products side by side, field by field, each value with its source page.

skills.name: get_order_route
skills.description: Get the maker's or distributor's trade channel to order a product, as the record states it. Never a consumer channel.

skills.name: create_order_intent
skills.description: Place an order intent for one to ten records (quantity, delivery market, optional date and note, the buyer's organisation and email). The Bourse routes it to each maker; verified makers answer with offers, and a maker's own Brand Agent address comes back with the routing. The email stays private: it is the buyer's key to read offers and accept one.

skills.name: get_offers
skills.description: Read the makers' offers on an order intent, and the order once placed. By the buyer's email given on create_order_intent.

skills.name: accept_offer
skills.description: Accept one offer and place the order through the Bourse. Accepting is one x402 paid call (HTTP 402 with the payment offer until paid): it settles and signs the order. The goods are paid between the two companies on the offer's own terms.

doors.name: The Library, market rules by country

doc.notice: Artificial intelligence makes mistakes. agent-bev is an information source, not a recommendation.
